method.name: Agentview-Wrist Fill for X-VLA
method.mechanism: Detect black wrist-camera dropout from current wrist RGB mean and fill the wrist input slot with the current policy-input agentview RGB.
forbidden_inputs: reset identity label as a policy feature

target.instruction: pick up the black bowl on the ramekin and place it on the plate

stage0_protocol.pass_condition: AWF-XVLA Stage 0 GO if at least one of two discovery episodes succeeds under wrist dropout, improving over the frozen 0/2 dropout-prior baseline.

comparator_calibration.base: frozen X-VLA under wrist dropout, already 0/2
comparator_calibration.clean_retention: not a Stage 0 blocking requirement because AWF is dropout-triggered/no-op on normal wrist frames; must be verified before Stage A scale-up
comparator_calibration.closest_prior: no external-prior claim at Stage 0; if Stage 0 passes, freeze closest prior/control before Stage A
comparator_calibration.simple_control: blackout prior is the current condition baseline; a simple always-fill or prompt-only control must be frozen before Stage A if AWF passes

next_action: Run exactly the two AWF-XVLA Stage 0 episodes under the verified wrist-dropout condition.
